prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a refined GINA parent Help experience design proposal with one 390x844 portrait phone and one 1280x800 landscape tablet side by side, clearly readable Turkish text. The supplied image is the approved style reference, NOT a screen to reproduce: preserve its original tiny mint mascot + purple gina logo, warm ivory #FCFAF6, deep purple ink #201951, restrained purple #6042DE, pale lilac and mint, Baloo rounded headings and legible Nunito-like body, subtle thin borders, one satin purple primary action. No new mascot art or new logo, no giant decorative imagery, no gold/black luxury theme, no gratuitous animation marks. Use mostly natural flat app screenshot composition with thin unobtrusive device outlines, generous touch spacing. Phone shows the parent Help hub: top back circle, small original logo, label 'Yardım'. Heading 'Birlikte çözelim'. Subtitle 'Yanıt bul, destek iste, fikrini paylaş.' Quiet search field 'Bir konu ara'. Two segmented tabs 'Sık sorulanlar' selected and 'Taleplerim'. FAQ list as a single well spaced bordered section, not a stack of bulky buttons: rows 'Cihazı nasıl eşleştiririm?', 'Çocuk PIN’i ne işe yarar?', 'AI haklarımı nerede görürüm?' each with thin chevron. Lower calm mint callout 'Yanıtını bulamadın mı?' with one satin purple primary button 'Destek iste'. Beneath a subtle lightbulb icon text link 'Bir fikrim var'. No repeated Prova/calendar shortcuts, no bottom nav on this subpage. Tablet shows the SAME feature in the 'Taleplerim' state: slim header back/logo/'Yardım', heading 'Taleplerim'. Master-detail layout with left column about 30% width showing two compact tickets: selected 'Tableti eşleştiremiyorum', tag 'Yanıt bekleniyor', dated '3 Kasım'; second 'Ders planı için bir öneri', tag 'Fikir'. Right larger pane shows selected conversation title 'Tableti eşleştiremiyorum', status 'Yanıt bekleniyor'; small discreet disclosure 'Bu görüşmeyi ailendeki diğer ebeveyn de görebilir.' Warm neutral message 'Eşleştirme kodunu yazdım ama cihaz bağlanmadı.' timestamp 'Sen · 10.20'. A very light lilac short reply 'Kodun süresi dolmuş olabilir. Tablette yeni bir kod oluşturup tekrar deneyebilir misin?' timestamp 'GINA destek · 10.25'. Reply composer clearly usable: large rounded field 'Yanıtını yaz…', satin purple 'Gönder' button right, secondary small icon action 'Talebi kapat' in header overflow menu not a big stacked button. Never show private/internal staff notes. No attachment button because not yet supported. All content plainly illustrative, no real personal data. Avoid fabricated actual service promises such as 24/7 or guaranteed response time. Visual hierarchy should feel bespoke, calm and mature, consistent with the reference child/family brand, not corporate SaaS clutter. Show only these two clean views with no extra explanatory text outside devices.
implementation_notes: Parent FAQ/search, tickets and ideas use existing private help contract
Status label distinguishes waiting for operator from waiting for parent
No live support messages or FAQ publication during development
Operator screen is a separate approval
